evidence.quote: Thematic courses and labs begin the week of January 30th and end the week of April 13th.
المساقات النوعية والمختبرات تبدأ في 7 فبراير و تنتهي في 13 إبريل

notes: English term text: 11 weeks (Jan 30 to Apr 13). Arabic term text: 10 weeks (Feb 7 to Apr 13). Alternative first meeting from the Arabic start: 2020-02-07. Term was cut by the spring 2020 lockdown in practice; the page does not say.
